arguments.value: Robert Gary Klausner (born 1941 in Los Angeles, California) is a United States District Judge for the Central District of California, appointed by President George W. Bush in 2002. He earned a B.A. in 1963 and a B.S. in 1964 from the University of Notre Dame, and received his J.D. from Loyola Law School in 1967. After serving in the U.S. Army from 1967 to 1969, he worked as a deputy district attorney in Los Angeles County from 1969 to 1974. He then served as a commissioner and judge of the Pasadena Municipal Court from 1974 to 1985, followed by service as a judge on the Superior Court of California for Los Angeles County from 1985 until his federal appointment in 2002.
